c1-first-run.outcome: A fresh address and the code 12345678 sign in and open onboarding
Every onboarding step can be completed, and the optional ones skipped, ending in the app
Going back and forward between onboarding steps keeps what was already entered
The name entered during onboarding shows as the preferred name in Settings → Preferences
The welcome dialog closes with Continue and does not come back
The first message gets the fake reply and the chat stays listed
After signing out keeping the data and signing in again with the same address, the earlier chat is there
After signing out with this device's data deleted and signing in again, the app works and a new message gets a reply
Deleting the account signs the user out, and signing in again with the same address starts a new, empty account

c2-chat-power-user.outcome: A thread of 12 or more messages, with a 2,000-character prompt and one with Markdown and code, shows every message in order with Markdown and code rendered
Stopping a reply mid-stream ends it, and the next message gets a full reply
Retrying or regenerating a reply gives a new reply in its place
A renamed chat shows its new name in the sidebar
A deleted chat is gone from the sidebar and the other chats remain
Clearing all chats leaves the sidebar without chats
The search palette finds a word from an earlier message, and opening the result shows that chat
Quoting part of an earlier message puts that part into the next message
sample.pdf and sample.png attached with the file picker are sent with the message and open from the thread
An attachment removed before sending is not sent
With "GLM 5.3 Flash", which is not configured here, the app shows an error for the message, and after switching back to "Opus 5" the next message gets a reply

c3-models-providers.outcome: The model picker lists "Opus 5", "GLM 5.3 Flash" and "GLM 5.3"
Each of those models answers a short prompt with a relevant reply
After switching the model in the middle of a thread, the new model's reply follows the earlier turns
The model selected in a thread is still the selected one
In three turns with "Opus 5" each reply follows the earlier turns, and after a stopped reply the next message gets a full one
In three turns with "GLM 5.3 Flash" each reply follows the earlier turns, and after a stopped reply the next message gets a full one
In three turns with "GLM 5.3" each reply follows the earlier turns, and after a stopped reply the next message gets a full one
A model disabled in Settings → Models is missing from the picker, and is back once enabled
A custom model can be added, edited and deleted in Settings → Models, and each change shows there
A custom model whose endpoint is unreachable (http://localhost:9) shows an error in its connection test and in chat, and nothing hangs
An empty or malformed endpoint URL is refused with a message

c4-skills-projects.outcome: A skill created in Settings → Skills shows in the list
The "Add a skill" button on the chat home creates a skill that then shows in Settings → Skills
A skill's edited name and instructions show in Settings → Skills
A disabled skill shows as disabled and is missing from the slash (/) popup; enabled again, it is back
A deleted skill is gone from Settings → Skills and from the slash popup
Skills reordered in Settings → Skills keep the new order
Typing / in the composer lists the enabled skills, and the one picked goes into the sent message
Invalid or unusual input in the skill form is refused with a message or saved intact, never breaking the list or logging an error
A project created with instructions shows in the sidebar with its instructions
A renamed project shows its new name
A project's edited instructions show in the project
A deleted project is gone from the sidebar
A chat moved into a project, then into another one, then out of projects, shows in the right place each time
Deleting a project that still has chats says what happens to them, and the chats end up as it said
Invalid or unusual input in the project form is refused with a message or saved intact, never breaking the sidebar or logging an error

c5-widgets-connections.outcome: Asking for the weather in a city renders a weather widget for that city
Asking to compare several cities on a map renders one map with all of them
Asking for a multiple-choice question renders a quiz whose answers can be clicked, and answering shows whether it was right
Asking for web resources gives a reply with sources, and its link previews and citations open inside the app
With sample.pdf attached, the reply states what the file really says, and the file opens in the viewer
Asking for a small HTML page with a click counter gives an artifact that opens, and its button counts clicks
An MCP server added at http://127.0.0.1:9879/mcp shows as connected, and asking for its echo tool runs the tool and shows its real result
Changing the server's URL to port 9 is refused or shows a connection error, and a chat that needs the tool says it failed without hanging
A removed MCP server is gone from the list
In a chat inside a project whose instructions set a clear, checkable rule (for example: end every reply with the word BANANA), the real reply follows the rule

c6-settings-data.outcome: A changed preferred name shows in Settings → Preferences
A chosen theme applies to the app
Another language translates the interface, and switching back restores English
A changed distance unit, temperature unit, time format and currency show as chosen
A set location shows in Preferences, and a cleared one stays cleared
The data collection switch and any proxy or privacy switch keep their state
Data exported, then deleted from this device, then imported again brings back the chats and the skill
Every other settings page opens without an error

c7-two-devices.outcome: Sync turns on for the same account on both devices, through any approval or recovery-key flow the app shows
A chat created on A shows on B without a reload, and B's rename and delete show on A
A skill created on A shows on B, and B's rename and delete show on A
A setting changed on one device (for example the theme) changes on the other
Settings → Devices on A lists both devices
Revoking B from A ends B's access, and B says so

c8-phone.outcome: The sidebar drawer opens and closes, and its contents fit the screen
Messages, a long one too, are sent and get the fake reply, and the thread fits the screen
A renamed chat shows its new name and a deleted one is gone
A skill created, edited and then deleted on the phone shows each change in Settings → Skills
The slash (/) popup fits the screen and puts the picked skill into the message
A project created on the phone shows in the sidebar, and once deleted it is gone
Preferences, Skills, Models, Connections and Devices open and fit the screen (the overflow check finds nothing)
A changed preferred name, theme and unit show as chosen
